sets.title: Authorization decision: phase-organized vs inline expression
sets.description: The same resource-authorization decision in three semantically equivalent forms: carrier A uses the pristine guard-clause form, carrier B uses a phase-organized style with descriptive comments per logical phase (sem_oo_split variant), and carrier C uses a semantically equivalent inline-only style without extracted helpers (sem_inline_extract variant). All three compute behaviorally identical results. No two carriers share a token run long enough for token/line tools to pair them, so only semantic detection is expected to recover the cluster.
sets.notes: SEM-03 variant (sem_oo_split) organizes logic into descriptive phases with comments. SEM-02 variant (sem_inline_extract) keeps all logic inline without helper extraction. Behavioral equivalence enforced by gen/seeds/access_guard/equivalence_test.php.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same auth vocabulary (user/resource/roles/grants/status) but computes a numeric trust score, not a boolean decision
